_comment: Copy this file to scripts/cctv-fetch.config.json and edit. The real config file is in .gitignore so per-machine paths and any future API keys never leave the workstation.

sources.name: Transport for London — JamCams
sources.notes: Open public endpoint, no API key required. Returns the full JamCams list with imageUrl in additionalProperties and lat/lon at the top level. Attribution required per TFL's open-data terms — record the camera ID in each zone's notes field.

sources.name: BBC London public feeds
sources.notes: Placeholder. If/when a stable public BBC London feed list exists, model it as either a manual-list (with the URLs hard-coded here) or extend cctv-fetch.ts with a new resolver kind.

sources.name: Studio manual archive ingest
sources.notes: Drop in cube-face extractions from the 360 archive here. Generate the cube face beforehand with ffmpeg's v360 filter — see docs/CCTV_PIPELINE.md.
